blocks.text: HOW CAN CHEMICAL PEEL NEAR Marble Falls HELP YOU?

blocks.html: A glycolic acid peel will exfoliate the outermost layer of your skin. It is considered the most conservative chemical peel available. This type of chemical peel for acne administered near Marble Falls is very safe and effective. We use it to treat other skin conditions as well, including dark patches, known as melasma. Once the treatment is done, your skin may appear pink for a while, but there is no real recovery time.

A salicylic acid peel is slightly stronger and goes somewhat deeper into the skin. For an increase in skin tones and skin texture, this type of chemical peel near Marble Falls is perfect. Your skin may feel a little tighter, and pinker initially, but there is no recovery time needed for this treatment. You may experience mild peeling after a few days. If you have oily or acne-prone skin, this is the chemical peel for acne scars that we recommended.
A salicylic acid peel or a glycolic acid peel is a mild to moderate chemical peel. They take just minutes to apply. There is no disruption to your day when scheduling one of these quick procedures.

For a medium depth chemical peel, our Victory Medical specialists near Marble Falls use trichloroacetic acid. Trichloroacetic acid is very effective for treating and correcting sun damage. It can also be used to remove freckles, as well as other pigmentation irregularities. If there are any pre-cancerous changes in your skin, this type of chemical peel can be used.

Once this type of chemical peel is administered, the skin is pink to red in color and feels very tight. You will need a recovery period for this type of treatment, due to the depth of the chemical peel itself. Peeling of the skin begins in 2 to 3 days and may last for a week or up to 10 days.

blocks.text: Why is a Chemical Peel near Marble Falls Right for You?

blocks.html: Chemical skin peels offer amazing and powerful ways to change the texture of your skin. Highly specialized acids and enzymes are applied to the outermost layers of dead skin cells. This causes superficial peeling and exfoliation. Once the dead skin cells are removed, the skin underneath begins to rejuvenate and reveal a glowing, more beautiful, and more youthful skin. For anyone with skin damage from the sun, Rosacea, acne, photo-aging or hyper-pigmentation, our chemical peels near Marble Falls can work wonders.
The benefits of a chemical peel include:

• Reduction of fine lines and wrinkles
• Skin cell renewal
• Reduction of acne flare-ups
• Minimization of pore size
• Decrease or elimination of hyper-pigmentation
• Improvement in the overall texture and tone of your skin
